$comment: [X4.11] Atlassian (Rovo) MCP attach spec. Tier-2 VERIFIED-PUBLISHER (publisher `atlassian` — official Atlassian Rovo MCP server, com.atlassian namespace; X1.14 evidence). Shape === mcp-specs/_template.json (X2.1). HOSTED http-sse remote endpoint (no local package), OAuth 2.1 auth. CC0-1.0.
title: Atlassian Jira & Confluence
description: Search, read, and create Jira work items and Confluence pages via the official hosted Atlassian Rovo MCP server.

auth.recipe: no static credential — the AI client performs an interactive OAuth 2.1 sign-in to your Atlassian Cloud account on first use; an optional API-token mode is also available. Actions run within the signed-in user's existing permissions.

sample_tools.name: getJiraIssue
sample_tools.summary: Get the details of a Jira issue by id or key.

sample_tools.name: searchJiraIssuesUsingJql
sample_tools.summary: Search Jira issues with a JQL query.

sample_tools.name: getVisibleJiraProjects
sample_tools.summary: List the Jira projects visible to the user.

sample_tools.name: getConfluencePage
sample_tools.summary: Get the content of a Confluence page.

sample_tools.name: searchConfluenceUsingCql
sample_tools.summary: Search Confluence content with a CQL query.

sample_tools.name: atlassianUserInfo
sample_tools.summary: Get the current Atlassian user's profile.

sample_tools.name: getAccessibleAtlassianResources
sample_tools.summary: List the Atlassian Cloud sites the user can access.

known_limitations: Authenticates via interactive OAuth 2.1 sign-in — the AI client runs a browser auth flow that respects your existing Jira/Confluence/Bitbucket permissions; an optional API-token mode is also available.
Hosted remote endpoint (https://mcp.atlassian.com/v1/mcp/authv2) — requires outbound network access; no local subprocess. Atlassian Cloud only (no FedRAMP/HIPAA support).
Site-level rate limits apply by plan (Free 500/hr; Standard/Premium/Enterprise 1000+/hr) — bulk operations can hit the cap.

Mutating tools (createJiraIssue, editJiraIssue, transitionJiraIssue, createConfluencePage, updateConfluencePage) act on real Atlassian data within the signed-in user's permissions; review high-impact changes before confirming.
Destructive-action audit (X2.18): no tool matches destructive name patterns (destructive_tools is empty); the trust policy keeps allowDestructive:false so mutating tools confirm per-call.

client_install.claude_desktop: Claude CLI: `claude mcp add --transport http atlassian https://mcp.atlassian.com/v1/mcp/authv2`, then run `/mcp` to complete the OAuth sign-in.
client_install.cursor: Add to ~/.cursor/mcp.json as `atlassian`: { type: http, url: https://mcp.atlassian.com/v1/mcp/authv2 }; authenticate via OAuth on first use.
client_install.vscode: Add to .vscode/mcp.json servers as `atlassian` with type `http` and url `https://mcp.atlassian.com/v1/mcp/authv2`; sign in via OAuth when prompted.
